title: The Best Smart Robotic Pool Cleaners
subtitle: Robotic pool cleaners with app control, ranked.
intro: We pulled the robotic pool cleaners on Amazon with app control and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: cordless operation, wall and waterline cleaning, and runtime.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: Beatbot Sora 10
awards.why: Beatbot's Sora 10 runs up to 300 minutes, cleans the waterline, and parks itself for pickup.

awards.label: Best Corded
awards.name: Dolphin Nautilus CC Plus Wi-Fi
awards.why: Dolphin's Nautilus CC Plus has always-on Wi-Fi scheduling and 3,307 reviews.

awards.label: Best Easy Retrieval
awards.name: Polaris Freedom SC
awards.why: Tap the Polaris and it climbs the wall to you.

systems_note: Only listings that name Wi-Fi are included. Aiper, WYBOT, and others have apps but don't say how they connect, and many use Bluetooth only near the pool.

products.name: Beatbot Sora 10 AI Navigation Pool Vacuum, 6,800 GPH, 5H Runtime
products.verdict: The longest runtime here, enough for pools up to 3,229 sq ft.

products.name: Polaris Freedom SC Cordless Robotic Pool Cleaner, WiFi Enabled
products.verdict: Climbs to the waterline when you tap it, so you never fish for it.

products.name: Dolphin Nautilus EON 100 Cordless Robotic Pool Cleaner, Wi-Fi, Wall & Waterline Scrubbing, Pools up to 50 ft
products.verdict: Dolphin's cordless robot for pools up to 50 feet.

products.name: Dolphin Nautilus CC Plus Wi-Fi Robotic Pool Cleaner with Wall Climbing Scrubber Brush, Pools up to 40 ft
products.verdict: The proven corded Dolphin, now with Wi-Fi scheduling.

buyers_guide.a: Cordless robots skip the tangled cable and are easier to drop in, but run 1.5 to 3 hours per charge. Corded models run as long as you want and are usually cheaper for the same cleaning.
Check the listing. Floor-only models are cheaper; wall and waterline cleaning needs stronger motors and better navigation.
Cleaning modes and schedules, battery level, and on some models a map of where it cleaned. Most apps connect over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi when the robot is out of the water.
